PSSSB Forester 2027 - Eligibility & Exam Pattern

Where Forester fits in PSSSB's forest recruitment and what to expect in 2027.

≈ 2 min to finish · Beginner

I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Forester posts are few, so the competition per seat is tough. If you are preparing for Forest Guard anyway, Forester is a natural add-on.

The last round was PSSSB Advertisement No. 07 of 2022 - 204 posts of Deputy Ranger, Forester and Forest Guard (200 of them Forest Guard). The Forester paper was held on 20 November 2022. No 2027 notification has been released yet.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Forester posts open only in small numbers, usually inside a Forest Guard drive. A 2027 round is possible but not confirmed. Prepare with the Forest Guard syllabus - it covers most of the ground.

The 2022 recruitment in brief

  • Posts: 204 in all - 200 Forest Guard, the rest Deputy Ranger and Forester.
  • Starting pay: Forester Rs 25,500 (Forest Guard Rs 21,700, Deputy Ranger Rs 35,400).
  • Age: 18-37 as on 1 January 2022, with relaxations.
  • Qualification: check the exact requirement in the next notice; reports of 2022 differ.

How PSSSB papers work now

For its recent advertisements PSSSB uses a two-part objective paper:

PartWhatRole
Part AMatric-level PunjabiQualifying - at least 50%
Part BPost-specific paper plus GK, reasoning and related subjectsMerit list is made only from Part B
  • Part B marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.
  • Standard rules: age 18-37 (up to 42 for SC/BC of Punjab, 45 for government employees); fee Rs 1,000 general, Rs 250 SC/BC/EWS, Rs 200 ex-servicemen, Rs 500 persons with disabilities. Confirm all of this in the next advertisement for this post.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the real paper: Forester paper of 20 November 2022.
  2. Use the Forest Guard plan - see our Forest Guard guide.
  3. Environment, forests and wildlife of Punjab.
  4. GK, reasoning and English for Part B.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

Which advertisement had PSSSB Forester posts?

Advertisement No. 07 of 2022, which combined Deputy Ranger, Forester and Forest Guard - 204 posts in all, of which 200 were Forest Guard.

What is the salary of a PSSSB Forester?

The 2022 advertisement gave a starting pay of Rs 25,500, compared with Rs 21,700 for Forest Guard and Rs 35,400 for Deputy Ranger.

When was the last Forester exam?

The Forester paper was held on 20 November 2022 (Set B in our archive).

What is the eligibility for Forester?

Reports of the 2022 notice differ on the exact qualification, so read the eligibility table in the next advertisement. Age was 18-37 as on 1 January 2022, with relaxations.

Will there be Forester posts in 2027?

Forester posts come in very small numbers alongside Forest Guard drives. Possible but not confirmed. No 2027 notification has been released yet.
